verdict.rationale: Unleash documents 'Variants' explicitly for A/B and multivariate testing (unleash-docs-8) and impact-metrics for automating rollout progression/pausing based on threshold metrics (unleash-docs-14, unleash-docs-22, unleash-docs-29), giving PMs building blocks to run experiments and gate on metrics. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated experiment results dashboard or statistical 'winning variation' analysis comparing variant performance against goal metrics — the impact-metrics feature is framed around automated safeguards/pausing rather than reporting which variant wins. missing for 10: statistical significance/winner reporting UI, dedicated experimentation results dashboard, independent corroboration of experiment analysis in practice.
